name: sim_spinor_torch_foundation
description: Torch-native Spinor geometry foundation: SU(2) rotation matrices, Weyl spinors ψ∈ℂ², spin-½ periodicity (2π→-I, 4π→I), Weyl projections — all torch float64 with autograd. numpy→torch migration proof-of-concept.

pytorch.reason: SU(2) rotation R(θ,n̂) via Pauli matrices σ, spinor ψ action, 2π/4π periodic behavior — all torch float64 with autograd

z3.reason: UNSAT: R(4π) ≠ I impossible (SU(2) spin-½ is forced to 4π-periodic)

cvc5.reason: z3 constraint solving sufficient for spinor periodicity UNSAT

sympy.reason: Symbolic SU(2) matrix structure and spinor periodicity J² = -I on spinor states

clifford.reason: Clifford algebra not needed for SU(2) rotation foundation

geomstats.reason: Riemannian geometry backend not needed for spinor migration

e3nn.reason: Equivariant neural networks not required for Weyl spinor sim

rustworkx.reason: Graph algorithms not applicable to spinor transformations

xgi.reason: Hypergraph structure not needed for spin-½ representation

toponetx.reason: Topological complexes not required for spinor foundation

gudhi.reason: Persistent homology not needed for SU(2) rotation foundation

P4_su2_preserves_norm.description: 2D rotation on (Re,Im) pairs preserves spinor norm

P6_autograd_spinor_rotation.description: Spinor rotation is differentiable w.r.t. SU(2) matrix via autograd

P8_weyl_projection_nonzero.description: Left-handed Weyl projection produces nonzero spinor component

N1_z3_spinor_periodicity_constraint.description: z3: SU(2) spinor is 4π-periodic (constraint is consistent)

N3_zero_spinor_stays_zero.description: Zero spinor remains zero under any rotation

B2_norm_continuity_small_rotation.description: Spinor norm varies continuously under small rotations

B3_tiny_angle_axis_independence.description: At tiny angles, rotation ≈ identity regardless of axis

migration_notes: This sim establishes the torch-native pattern for Spinor family migration. Next: port spinor lego sims to use these primitives.
